title: Equal Opportunity Cell | KPGU
content: t Registration Notes Submit the complaint within one month from the date of the incident or last incident in a series. Include full name, designation, mobile no, email id, and enrolment no in case of student. Describe the incident clearly, including date, time, location, respondent's name and relationship. The committee follows the KPGU policy on the prevention of discriminations among all. CONTACT DETAILS Reach Out Anti Discrimination Committee Drs.
